name: Animated Mukradi Heads
disable: DC 40 Occultism check or DC 40 Religion check (expert) three times to cast out the souls animating the heads
reset: The hazard deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area or after all three heads are destroyed. After 1 hour, if at least one head remains, the hazard reactivates.
routine: (3 actions) For each mukradi skull disabled or destroyed, the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, a different head moves up to 30 feet and attempts a maw Strike against a different living creature.

items.name: Breathe Energy
items.text:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the mukradi heads

---
Effect Each head rises off the wall and moves up to 30 feet. The first head then breathes a 10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line of acid dealing 4d10 acid damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). The second head breathes a 30-foot cone of fire dealing 4d10 fire damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). The third head breathes a 60-foot line of electricity dealing 4d10 electricity damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). The hazard rolls initiative.

text: Three mukradi heads, animated by the souls of Zyphaniss's victims, rise into the air and fire energy throughout the room.
